text:
anya: Quick sync — we need a defensible, buyer-facing routing + isolation promise for the longash term roadmap. Sales wants a one-liner + clear launch gates.

mason: From eng: recommend a tiered model (gold/silver/bronze) mapped to measurable acceptance tests. Avoid promising identical RTOs across hosted/dedicated.

sarah: Product: one-pager should show promise, how to qualify, and tradeoffs (cost & onboarding). Sales also asks for a sample SLA bullet and pilot checklist.

luca: Ops: contractual isolation requires reserved slices, warm-cache onboarding, and an eviction choreography. We can ship policy templates first (`reserved-slice`, `shared-guarded`, `preemptible-evict`). DSL later.

omar: Sales feedback: customers want a single sentence they can show execs — keep it simple and tiered. Also pilot customers want a runnable test they can watch.

anya: Draft promise: "Predictable regional latency and optional isolation tiers — validated by acceptance tests and backed by contract for reserved Dedicated customers."

mason: Proposed launch gates (eng-readable + sales-friendly):
- eligibility: committed throughput or Dedicated reservation signed
- isolation_probe_v1: 25k cross-tenant probes -> zero KV collisions
- regional_latency_check: P99 within declared band at 60% target load
- failover_drill: tiered RTOs (gold=45s, silver=90s, bronze=best-effort)
- operational readiness: eviction playbook, billing delta, and signed onboarding plan

sarah: I'll turn that into a one-pager and sample SLA clause once eng posts test names and ops gives template IDs.

luca: Ops action: publish template IDs + short runbook mapping runtime knobs to tiers (batching, cache, quantization). ETA Tue.

mason: Eng action: land minimal harness scripts for isolation_probe_v1 and latency check and post README. ETA Mon.

release-bot: Created ticket PROD-9999: "Routing & tenant isolation: product pledge + gates" assigned to mason.

anya: We'll review the one-pager in Friday roadmap review. Keep responses short here. :thumbsup:
